But safer: we can make each section content be a single line and not put blank lines between sections, but then there will be no blank line, so the whole thing might be considered one paragraph? The Guardian issued corrections clarifying that the new pet theft law applies only to England and Northern Ireland, not the whole UK, and that Eileen Burbidge is the executive director of Fertifa while its founders are Tony Chen and Nick Kuan.
